verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਬੈਨ ਚੋਰ ਸੋ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: has has bain chor so kahai ||

pu.ss: ਉਹ ਚੋਰਾ ਦੇ (ਨਾਇਕ ਦੇ) ਹੱਥਾ ਨੂੰ ਹੱਥਾ ਨਾਲ ਪਕੜ ਕੇ

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਹਾਥ ਹਾਥ ਸੋ ਗਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: taa ko haath haath so gahai ||

en.bdb: (To leader of the thieves who was in the kitchen) She talked to him jovially by giving her hand in his.
(To leader of the thieves who was in the kitchen) She talked to him jovially by giving her hand in his.

pu.ss: ਉਹ ਗੱਲਾ ਨਾਲ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਵਰਚਾਉਾਂਦੀ ਰਹੀ

en.bdb: She gave him pleasure through her talks while she put oil (on fire) to boil.(11)

pu.ss: ਅਤੇ ਆਪ ਬੈਠੀ ਤੇਲ ਕਾਹੜਦੀ ਰਹੀ ॥੧੧॥
